body:
Psilocybin Microdose Heaven
A night out with some new company resulted in a very fun microdosing experience!
9pm: Took my regular dose of gabapentin 900mg before venturing out.
10pm: met a friend who invited me to join a small gathering. We drank some beers (approx 2 for me) and I was offered Mushroom Chocolate, dosage unknown, but packaging said 1-3 pieces for microdose, 4-5 for therapeutic, and 6-9 for "Astral projection". Of course I took 2! Have experience with psilocybin, albeit a couple of years and felt comfortable with the company and responsible friend!
10:20ish pm: started to notice the soft but euphoric effects starting to kick in, felt very comfortable with everyone and relaxed. Environment was a little dulled but figured the alcohol would have done that. Had another light beer.
10:45-11pm: everyone talking and laughing, all had partaken in dosing, some taking more than others. Everyone seems to be having a good time, laughing and joking. But overall calm.
12pm: spent a while talking and enjoying time. Decided to retire last, and walked with everyone home. Unlocked my door and realized the psilocybin had kicked in more than I thought it would. Again, likely the alcohol interfering. Put on headphones and decided to play some house and lay down in the dark.
No visuals but an overall smooth and euphoric feeling, with very little stimulant effects. Mostly calm and enjoyable, music is very atmospheric and something to focus on.
12:30am: writing this now. Still feel calm with the euphoric effects but softly. Would definitely like to take a walk and listen to music.
My experience here was overall great, very calming and opening. Although I
do still have a stomach ache.
No palpitations, anxiety, or jitters.
Just very enjoyable still, even 2.5 hours later. This will likely last about 4 hours before the effects start to fade. But with music, a calm and quiet, dark environment; very therapeutic and overall just nice!
